p: Woodhorn Road is a busy road through Ashington town centre, a town built on coal. Admiral is an 18+ venue, adults only.

Ashington's story is told brilliantly at Woodhorn Museum, built on the site of the old colliery, where you can see the Pitmen Painters' famous works. Next door, the Queen Elizabeth II Country Park has a lake and woodland trails. Football fans will know Ashington as the hometown of Bobby and Jack Charlton and Jackie Milburn. Since the Northumberland Line reopened, trains run from Ashington to Newcastle, so you can visit without the car.
